annotations.text: FINAL FOUR — one layout, four skins. Resume bar now sits at the TOP, under the plaque. Games are fixed: 3 of Spade (numeral 3 + black spade), KaChuFull (diagonal saltire carrying all four suits), More Coming Soon (an intentional ghost tile, not a broken one), Archives. Both game logos are drawn per skin so each belongs to its own palette. Hover the tiles: they lift, the art scales inside the frame, a sheen crosses it, and each logo animates - the spade pulses, the KaChuFull suits spin.
A · TERMINAL CLASSIC — charcoal chrome, trapezoid plaque, condensed caps. The faithful read of your reference photo.
B · SLOT MACHINE — red carnival ground, marquee plaque with chasing bulbs, hard offset shadows, confetti falling behind the page.
C · NEON TERMINAL — indigo, neon-tube plaque that flickers, glowing tile frames. The online-casino read.
D · TROPICAL TABLE — turquoise felt with a shimmer, arched white plaque, coral and sunshine accents, fully rounded strip.
